rules.when: The issue has the label modell:text, or the task writes docs, pitch scripts, or copy against an agreed plan. Unclear product decisions still use modell:schwer.
rules.why: Use a cheap model for specified writing tasks.

rules.when: The issue has the label modell:klein, or the task is a small, fully specified change in one or two files with a direct pass/fail check.
rules.why: Pay-per-use budget: cheapest model for easy work.

rules.when: The issue has the label modell:ui, or the task is user-facing UI that the judges see in the demo, or the shared API contract.
rules.why: Good quality at a fraction of the strongest model's price.

rules.when: The issue has the label modell:schwer, or the task is hard or unclear: architecture, a risky multi-file change, or planning.
rules.why: Only the hardest work gets the most expensive model.
